system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; the repo is MedCPT (retriever), not the AgentMD harness. The prompts are in the Supplementary Materials, which are not in the evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: AgentMD first retrieves the top 10 most relevant calculators to the patient note using MedCPT, a foundation model for embedding biomedical texts, and then selects the eligible tool with LLMs.
env_context_strategy.evidence_locator: paper Results (Applying RiskCalcs to Patient Notes)
env_context_strategy.note: Retrieval is over the tool collection, not over a repository.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the Python interpreter returns the printed results or error messages when executing the code
observation_format.evidence_locator: paper Results (Applying RiskCalcs to Patient Notes)

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The Python Interpreter runs all the code blocks in the AgentMD response and returns either the successful running results or error messages

tool_count.note: Uses a Python interpreter plus 2,164 RiskCalcs functions. The count of the tool schema is not stated.

edit_primitive.note: No harness tool registry is available. This is not a file-editing domain.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: AgentMD uses GPT-4 to write structured medical calculators from these articles
tool_schema_source.note: The tools are LLM-generated. The closest value is auto_generated.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The returned message from the Python Interpreter is then appended to the AgentMD messages, and AgentMD will be prompted again to generate the next analysis or updated code.
loop_primitives.note: The pipeline runs selection, then computation, then summarization. The computation step is a ReAct-style loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: including three main steps: selection, computation, and summarization
planning_granularity.evidence_locator: paper Results (Applying RiskCalcs to Patient Notes)

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: AgentMD, a novel language agent capable of curating and applying clinical calculators

self_verification.note: GPT-4 verification applies to tool creation, not to the inference run.
